newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Four disciplined at ABN AMRO diamond office.
newsitem.headline: Four disciplined at ABN AMRO diamond office.

text.p: Three client advisors at the diamond office of Dutch bank ABN AMRO have been suspended and a fourth sacked over allegations of irregular conduct, newspaper Het Financieele Dagblad said on Saturday.
The newspaper, quoting an ABM AMRO spokesman, said there had been "irregularities" and that the employees had not acted in accordance with "internal procedures".
Noone was immediately available at ABN AMRO to comment.
The paper said no charges against any of the four had yet been brought and that an investigation by the bank was still in its "early stages".
ABN AMRO is the world leader in diamond financing with offices in Amsterdam, Antwerp, Geneva, Bombay, New York and London. It is also involved in diamond processing and transport.
